acceptance_status: Automated full-inventory checkpoint; full functional/native/manual/performance/release parity remains open.
scope: Nineteen fixed preference actions and dynamic site-rule removal/pagination use the existing Rust action geometry, pointer/key reducer and primitive recipes with Metal text and matching CPU fallback. Native Button/focus/AX/event and View group nodes remain adapters.

build_input_snapshot.gn_delta: No target/dependency change. Rust bridge adds clear_selection for existing SelectState. Explicit native adapters, preference selector allocation/refresh and browser tests changed. Concurrent root network-policy work remains excluded.
build_input_snapshot.method: Committed archive with explicit prototype overrides, including page_dialogs.cc/h, and unchanged shared-service install/stage hooks, excluding concurrent root network-policy work. Final staging idempotent and Ninja no-work.

native_service_patch.license: Generated Chromium header and source hook retain the Chromium BSD-style license; project adapter/tool/model changes use Apache-2.0.

additional_performance_scenario_coverage.purpose: Execute all four opt-in performance scenarios as additional automated coverage, with their default 30 trials. Metal validation is enabled; these are not controlled CPU/GPU/drawable presentation comparisons.

contracts: The native Views backend retains its original direct MdTextButton hierarchy. The Rust backend reuses SceneTextButton and the existing Rust action layout/scene/input model, with native font/inset/color metrics and no hidden child Labels.

Single actions in horizontal preference rows preserve intrinsic measurement width under a bounded native height-for-width query. The vertical More rules action retains full-width stretch. SceneActionGroup observes visible viewport changes, and profile/hide/offscreen transitions cancel latched input.

Cocoa Space commits a font family to the original active-profile store. IME preedit and disabled editor/action admission do not commit. Clear-data busy state disables the same button, changes the rendered and AX label, and restores admission afterward.

Real Cocoa pagination replaces 50 rule actions with all 55 and destroys the old More node safely. Deferred Remove actions reject a changed active profile, then remove one rule under the correct profile while preserving the other profile.

The Metal fixture verifies 19 fixed action roles with no native MdTextButton or child-label painting, stale-profile/hide cancellation, actual compositor viewport exclusion/reappearance and cancellation of a scrolled-out press. Original editor/selector assertions remain unchanged.
remaining_preference_controls: native ScrollView/BoxLayout/View and Button event/focus/AX ownership
limits: Remaining settings navigation/chrome/form state, other browser/service panels, dialog/outer/native Views nodes and complete functional parity remain open.
Manual native candidate-window/VoiceOver/complex bidi/scale/theme/pointer/GPU-recovery and signed bundle/session acceptance remain open.
Default-30-trial optional performance scenarios provide execution coverage only; no controlled CPU/GPU/drawable-presentation speedup is claimed.

Normal installed applications/profiles are untouched. No bundle is packaged or signed. No new library/crate/dependency. Final shipped-binary Apache-2.0/upstream notice checks remain release acceptance.

initial_critical_investigation.layout: The initial horizontal action group reported the bounded available width as its own preferred width. The native height-for-width query then starved the row text/editor column, undermeasuring scroll contents and clipping the languages/last-font editor. Final preference row groups preserve intrinsic width; vertical list actions retain stretch. Native Views hierarchy and original editor/selector reachability conditions are retained.
initial_critical_investigation.inventory: The initial name-only action inventory counted the History checkbox together with the History action. Final inventory also requires the Button role; it still rejects all native MdTextButton nodes and child-label painting.
